paper.title: Skip the Hessian, Keep the Rates: Globalized Semismooth Newton with Lazy Hessian Updates
paper.version: November 2026 camera-ready manuscript (figure numbering checked against revision 38); public arXiv v1 has older experimental settings

paper_location: Section 5.1 and Appendix E.1, equation (26), Table 3

configuration.adam_scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau per update on pre-update loss; factor .5, patience 5, threshold 1e-5, min_lr 1e-6

environment.timing: CPU perf_counter wall time, including diagnostics; model construction excluded
environment.timing_continuation: CPU perf_counter per update including diagnostics; legacy timings retained; state recovery, checkpoint copies/I/O and printing excluded

notes: Results were copied byte-for-byte; no training was performed during packaging.
The Nov7 figure export has exactly the same histories and labels as this saved dataset. The figure styles match camera-ready Figures 1, 2 and 6.
The dataset includes an additional m=20 trajectory that is not plotted in the paper.
Saved source paths and the older manuscript reference inside the pickle are historical provenance; loading does not require those paths.
All training samples, initial weights, final weights, histories and available optimizer checkpoints are included.
